info.name: Inspect360 integration
info.summary: Nextcloud integration for Njordium Inspect360 — bring vendor and assessment data from the Inspect360 TPRM platform into your Nextcloud dashboard.
info.description:
Nextcloud integration app for Njordium Inspect360.
## Dashboard widgets
- **Overview** — four KPI tiles: Approved Vendors, Total Vendors, Pending Review, Total Services. Powered by a single call to /api/v1/suppliers/stats plus a lightweight products count. - **Approved Vendors** — list of suppliers with status "approved", with country, org number, and regulatory flag chips (Critical, ICT, Data Processor, AML) at a glance. - **Added Vendors** — recently added suppliers, sorted by created-at descending. - **Assessed** — recent vendor assessments with status, current stage, and colour-coded risk level (low/medium/high/critical).
Each widget carries a per-user refresh cadence (Never / 30s / 1m / 5m default / 15m / 30m / 1h), pauses polling while the browser tab is hidden, and re-fetches on wake so an idle dashboard tab doesn't hammer the API.
## Authentication
Sign in with your Inspect360 email and password from Personal Settings → Connected accounts. The app exchanges your credentials for a JWT refresh token (stored encrypted via Nextcloud's ICrypto), discards the password, and mints short-lived access tokens on demand for every API call.
Only Inspect360 accounts without multi-factor authentication are supported in this release — accounts with MFA enforced, password-change-required, or MFA-enrolment-required will see a targeted "not supported yet" message and can wait for a future release with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow.
info.author: Kim Haverblad
